name: Broken Vessel
description: The shape of this creature... I have seen something like it before. More than once, perhaps. It looks a little like the bugs of Hallownest, but not quite the same. Where did these empty little wanderers come from?

name: Brooding Mawlek
description: I hear this beast crying out sometimes as I prowl the caverns, although I've never actually laid eyes on it. Who or what is it calling for? As far as I can tell, its voice is never answered.

name: Oro & Mato
description: "Gods by toil and nail bound, Brothers sworn to guard the weak, Masters of the sacred ground, Help Us find the God We seek!"
health: 500 Phase 1, 1600 Phase 2, Total 2100

name: The Collector
description: A shadow that sometimes flits through the caverns, making strange noises to itself. I've never seen it clearly so I have no idea what type of creature it is.

name: Crystal Guardian
description: Heavyset miner of the Crystal Peak overcome by crystal growth. Can discharge blazing beams of light from its crystalllised sic limbs.

name: Dung Defender
description: Fighting for 'honour', or for 'loyalty'... you may as well be fighting for dust. If you want to kill, do it for your own sake. That is the nature of a true Hunter.
reward: Defender's Crest and Access to Isma's Cove

name: False Knight
description: Weak creatures love to steal the strength of others. Their lives are brief and fearful, and they yearn to have the power to dominate those who have dominated them.

name: Flukemarm
description: The desire to breed, to leave behind a memory of ourselves in the shape of a child... it seems to be etched deep into the heart of every living creature. I too have felt the pull of that base instinct.

name: God Tamer
description: Some hunters train beasts to join them in chasing down prey. I tried it once, but couldn't resist the urge to test my companion's strength against mine.

name: Great Nailsage Sly
description: "Sagely God of the cunning and bold, Sharpen Our nails and show Us the odds, O greatest of masters, We wish to behold, That one still greater, the God of Gods!"

name: Grimm
description: "Through dream I travel, at lantern's call, To consume the flames of a kingdom's fall."

name: Gruz Mother
description: Bizarrely, this monster does not lay eggs but instead carries its young inside of its fat stomach. This strange practice seems to exhaust the creature, making it sleepy and vulnerable. Take advantage!

name: Hive Knight
description: Some creatures are born with duties and loyalties marked indelibly upon their minds. They are strong, but they are also slaves.

name: Hollow Knight
description: The old King of Hallownest... he must have been desperate to save his crumbling little world. The sacrifices he imposed on others... all for nothing.

name: Hornet (Protector)
description: I have seen this nimble little creature. I thought her prey and pounced at her, but with a flash she stabbed me with her flying stinger and darted away. Could she be... a Hunter?

name: Mantis Lords
description: The Mantis tribe and the bugs of old Hallownest had no love for each other. The Mantises outlived their rivals though, and their civilisation still stands.
reward: Deepnest (Lower Entrance), Mark of Pride, Hallownest Seal, 620 Geo, Bench

name: Massive Moss Charger
description: There is strength in numbers, yes, but these creatures never had much strength to begin with. Cut through their trickery!

name: Nosk
description: In the deepest darkness, there are beasts who wear faces stolen from your memories and pluck at the strings in your heart. Know yourself, and stay strong.

name: Oblobbles
description: Having a mate by your side... one that will never leave you until death. Strange. No mate has ever come forth to stay by my side...

name: Paintmaster Sheo
description: "O God inspired, master of arts, Whose works shall eternal endure, Peer beyond Our minds and hearts, Reveal to Us the God most pure!"

name: Radiance
description: The plague, the infection, the madness that haunts the corpses of Hallownest... the light that screams out from the eyes of this dead Kingdom. What is the source? I suppose mere mortals like myself will never understand.

name: Soul Master
description: The bugs of Hallownest tried all kinds of tricks and rituals and prayers to rid themselves of the infection. But to no avail! Perhaps the infection came from somewhere deep inside of them that they could not escape.

name: Soul Warrior
description: Where these strange warriors go, whispers follow them. Not only are they skilled with a nail, they can also use some strange power to shift suddenly from place to place. Stay on guard.
health: 180, 300 (Elegant Key Room)
reward: 200 Geo (Soul Sanctum), 300 Geo and Shade Soul (From Elegant Key Room)

name: Traitor Lord
description: I have felt that desire. The desire to take the infection into myself. To become stronger, more powerful... these thoughts haunt my dreams during the darkest times. A false hope, but it can burn so brilliantly in one's mind.

name: Uumuu
description: The canyon below us, the one thick with fog and crackling with strange energy... a Hunter can lose their senses down there. Be careful... strange and unnatural things lurk there.

name: Vengefly King
description: A filthy creature that is happy to chew on any old thing it finds discarded on the cavern floor. When it notices a threat it will annoyingly scream and shriek, so kill it swiftly.

name: Watcher Knight
description: When these silent warriors fall in battle, their bodies split open and strange bugs come flying out. I wonder, what will come flying out of me when I die? Will my hopes and fears drift away into the darkness?
reward: 655 Geo, Hallownest Seal and access to Lurien the Watcher

name: Zote
description: Some rare creatures are so weak, so helpless, so inept and so irritating that hunting them gives no pleasure.
